newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Corp launches risk control office.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Corp launches risk control office.

text.p: Sumitomo Corp said on Monday it had launched an office of market risk management for all commodities following the $2.6 billion losses incurred by its former star trader.
It said in a statement that the office, which began operations on Monday, is headed by executive vice president Takehiko Yonezu.

Sumitomo's internal system of checks and controls came under close scrutiny after its former copper king Yasuo Hamanaka was fired last June over unauthorised trading over 10 years which caused the biggest market losses in history. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk (+81-3-3432-7391)
